sections.title: Structures and Materials for Spacecraft
sections.description: This course provides an introduction to the structural and materials engineering challenges associated with spacecraft systems and the extreme environments in which they must function, including launch, operation in space, and other demanding mission environments. This course will introduce the physics and mechanics relevant to these systems. Through this lens, the course will also provide a critical study of historical and contemporary space systems. Students will learn how mission objectives, subsystem interactions, environmental conditions, and safety requirements are translated into structural requirements and materials selection decisions. The course emphasizes systems-level thinking and design trade-offs, where each design decision creates both solutions and new challenges.
